title: Terraform licensing changed from MPL to BSL

canonical_premises.statement: Future Terraform releases must remain under an OSI-approved open-source license.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: An OSI-approved open-source license is a hard procurement requirement.

canonical_premises.statement: Future Terraform releases will continue under MPL 2.0.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: The decision assumes future Terraform releases continue under MPL 2.0.
